mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at 70 degrees near City Hall. If you are an early riser, you might catch the International Space Station passing overhead at 4:51 AM. It will rise in the south southeast over Oregon and head toward the east southeast near Festival Foods for a two-minute window.

In local updates, the Verona Police Department recently arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after reports of dangerous driving. Additionally, the City of Verona has recently updated its zoning and sign ordinance, and residents are reminded to double-check their polling locations using the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading to the polls.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square and live music at Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving while students were on board. Fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's of Verona will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
